notes.title: Major Map, Biome, and Base Deco Update is Out Now!
notes.content:
Hey Ruins To Fortress players!
Ruins to Fortress is stepping up with its biggest update yet! After the successful Early Access release in December and months of technical fine-tuning, version 0.5.0 brings a massive overhaul to the core gameplay of this 2D survival title.

The update consists of multiple major expansions. With New Horizons, the game world has been reimagined: for the first time, players will explore procedurally generated maps, featuring a completely revamped biome system. Eight diverse biomes – from icy tundras to scorching deserts – introduce fresh challenges and strategic depth. Instead of one large island, players will now navigate multiple islands, and even the size of the map is customizable.

Looking to make your base feel more like home? The Homestead update adds 20 new decorative items, including functional clocks, atmospheric light sources like lava lamps and torches, houseplants, and even a working radio. Every base can now become a truly personal space.

On the gameplay side, version 0.5.0 introduces dangerous underground bunkers for daring players to explore. In addition, new destructible NPC bases offer fresh PvE opportunities and valuable loot. And to top it off, a wide range of quality-of-life improvements have been implemented – including a fully redesigned building system with snap-to-grid functionality, visible snap points, a reworked clan manager, and a handy minimap.

Note: Save games from the old static map version are not compatible with the new version, and vice versa.
[hr][/hr]Map System
Seed-based worlds: every game generates a unique map unless you enter a custom seed

Manually choose seed and map size

More detailed map options unlock after testing
[hr][/hr]Biomes
Tundra · Steppe · Forest · Meadows · Rocklands · City · Savanna · Desert
[hr][/hr]New Features and Improvements
New tree types

New monument: Underground bunker

Destructible NPC bases you can loot

Grenades are now bouncier

Player drones and boats now consume fuel

Drones can move up and down using the jump key (Space)

Minimap shows other clan members, your bed, last death, biomes, and monuments; areas unlock as you explore

Torchlight and headlamps now shine higher and lower vertically, making it easier to spot boats in the water

Day/Night Cycle: Night time is now 4x faster than daytime

Rain now has a minimum cooldown of 30 minutes before it can appear again

If a player gets stuck for example between a npc or player base, the game will try to spawn an "emergency boat" nearby after a couple of minutes

The nuke explosion will only affect 30% of the area within its blast radius. Player bases and clan bases are protected and won't be destroyed

Improved sorting for craftable items and buildings, now color-coded to highlight commonly used items

Item and building damage is now more clearly visible with HP values and percentage left, so it’s easier to see what you’re damaging during a raid or if your attacks are even making a difference.


[hr][/hr]Building System
Simplified build zone: place a workbench to project a visible blueprint area

Zone grows larger with each workbench upgrade

Background tiles and electricity work inside your build zone

Snap-to-grid for parts and items (hold Shift for exact alignment)

Visible snap points guide precise construction
[hr][/hr]Clan Manager
Clan and map controls moved into your inventory tab

Invite any online player on your server to join your clan
[hr][/hr]Bug Bounty: Crimis Basecap Skin or Magos Basecap Skin
Report a valid, not-already-reported bug on Discord or Steam Discussions

Or share cool gameplay content like a beta livestream, a unique base screenshot, or a good gameplay video

Include steps to reproduce, screenshots or video, and F1 console logs for bug reports

Skins will be given at Crimis or Magos’ discretion: Crimis Basecap or Magos Basecap

Cheers Crimi & Mago

notes.title: BETA: New Horizons Update is LIVE
notes.content:
Hey Ruins To Fortress players!
After six months in Early Access, we’re super excited to release our biggest update yet, now available as a public beta! We've dedicated countless hours to rework the system, completely transforming the old hand-placed map into a unique, dynamic world featuring islands with diverse biomes.
[hr][/hr]What Is a Beta?
A beta is a test version with new features. Your feedback helps us improve the update before it becomes the main version.
We really appreciate your help testing a multiplayer game this size takes a lot of time!
[hr][/hr]How to Join the Beta[olist]
Open your Steam Library and right-click Ruins To Fortress

Select Properties › Betas

Choose beta - join the beta for the upcoming map update (beta versions start with 0.4.x)

Steam will download the update

To return to the live version, open the same menu and select None
[/olist]
Note: Save games are now stored in separate folders and won’t be compatible with the old static map version. This beta will run for about one month before becoming the main build.

notes.title: Defense Items Update - Version 0.3.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Version 0.3.0 introduces an overhaul of the satoshi mining system, adjustments to electric systems, and exciting new defense items to Ruins To Fortress. Share your feedback in the comments or on Discord, let us know what you love and what could be improved!

Highlights

New Defense Items: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716333/2e5ab067dc0d229f4483f388ce01f0e248140c75.png

 Death Spike: A sharp spike trap that injures anyone who steps on it.
 Iron Bite: A strong bear trap with reinforced metal teeth, built to wound enemies.
 Havoc Mine: A pressure-activated explosive that shreds unlucky players who trigger it.
 Sand Wall: A durable sandbag barrier that shields against bullets and explosions.
 Bastion: A fortified turret platform that can hold different guns (Pistol, Shotgun, Uzi, AK-47) for defense. Requires electricity and the right ammo to function.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716333/86f82f05ca19acc2d2b652dd3dbcf053aee487ed.png
Satoshi Mining system overhaul and Electric systems adjustements: 
The Satoshi mining system is a great way to earn in-game currency, and it now unlocks earlier than before, along with many electric items. Satoshis will no longer drop as often. You will need to mine them, grow crops, or sell items at vending machines to earn them.

To make power management easier, essential electric items for building the grid have been moved from Workbench 3 to Workbench 1. Solar panels now generate more electricity, and batteries store more energy, making your power system more efficient.

Mining System Overview 
The mining system lets players earn rewards by running mining racks. Each mining rack contributes to the global hashrate, which determines the difficulty and reward distribution.  

 Hashrate & Difficulty: The system adjusts difficulty based on total mining power, keeping rewards balanced.  
 Rewards: Players receive satoshis based on their mining contribution, with bonuses for consistency.
 Bonuses & Achievements:Mining streaks and catch-up mechanics boost earnings, and players can unlock achievements by accumulating rewards.  
 Live Updates: You’ll receive chat messages updating you on bonuses, milestones, and mining streaks, helping you stay informed.  

Keep your miners running, manage power to earn the best rewards!

Bug Fixes & Improvements

 Fixed a bug where repairing items inside containers, such as chests, was not working.
 Fixed an issue where, after saving and loading the game, NPCs would not spawn correctly if the in-game days had progressed beyond two. Now, the correct number of NPCs will appear based on the selected difficulty.
 Fixed item stacking bugs for produced items in planter boxes and other containers.
 Added new console command "dlc_reload" to restore missing DLC items if they were not granted correctly


Upcoming Features in the Pipeline

 Explore the new Bunker and Silo System - discover underground bases and hidden loot
 Raid NPC bases packed with valuable resources and equipment
 Experience bigger maps with more room to explore and build
 New biomes and areas to discover, each with unique challenges
 Battle challenging new NPCs and epic boss encounters
 Full mod support to customize your game experience
 New items
 Create your perfect character with the new character creator


Don't miss out on our Survivors Pack DLC or the stunning Serpent's Dawn Skin Pack.

Happy gaming!

Markus & Simon

notes.title: Major Update - Version 0.2.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Version 0.2.0 introduces exciting updates to game mechanics and resource management. Share your feedback in the comments or on Discord, let us know what you love and what could be improved!

Highlights

Difficulty Settings: A dropdown menu now controls overall gameplay settings, replacing the day/night cycle and outlaw disable options. Choose from the following:

Easy: No raids, always daytime, stable resources.
Normal: Raids from Day 2, gradual resource decline.
Hard: Raids from Day 1, tougher raids, faster resource decline, no respawns or saves.
Hardcore: Raids from Day 1, tougher raids, one life, resource scarcity, no respawns or saves.

Example for Normal Difficulty:
Day 1: Peaceful exploration
Day 2: The bear raid begins, resources start declining a bit and aggressive NPCs begin to spawn.
Day 3+: NPC raids intensify with grenades.
Day 5+: Raids include C4, making survival even tougher
Day 6+...

A detailed explanation can be found in our wiki.

Raids now start at moonrise, with distinct music playing depending on whether a raid is triggered or it's a peaceful night. The bear attack from placing raw meat in a campfire has been removed, along with the raid triggered by defeating the red soldier near the bunker. Raids are now predictable, providing a clear rhythm and game loop.

We hope that the combination of PvP and PvE game modes, along with the variety of difficulty options, offers something for everyone.

New Vending Machine System: Vending machines are now categorized into Crafting, Food, and Ammunition, making them easier to use and navigate.

Resource Management: Adjusted loot drops, crafting materials, resource costs, and stack sizes to balance loot and prevent inventory overflow. 

Weapon Upgrade: Improved firing angles make it easier to hit targets from higher or lower positions.

We are truly excited to hear your thoughts on the changes and the direction we’re taking with the game. Your feedback is incredibly valuable, so please share your impressions with us in the comments, on Discord, or in the Steam Forums!

The game will continue to have the three main modes: PvP (Player vs. Player), PvE (Player vs. Environment), and Deathmatch. These will stay in the game to let players choose how they want to play, whether it's teaming up, fighting other players, or competing in all-out battles.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716333/a65b9e8892d8a177c7bedd13b785f82d14415649.jpg

Bug Fixes & Improvements
- Save game limits can now be set individually
- Peaceful nights and raid events now feature appropriate soundtracks
- Highwalls can no longer be placed too close together
- Placement of large items like beds and large wood boxes is now easier, even near fuse boxes
- Boat Interaction: Entering boats near other items now works as intended
- Fixed translation error when hammer breaks
- Reduced durability wear for tools and weapons
- Balanced weapon stats: pistols are stronger, arrows slightly weaker
- Resolved NPC bug with floating chickens and wandering behavior
- Clearing leftover buildings and floating items better.

Reminder:
-The free early adopter shirt skin drop will no longer be available after this update.
-All Xmas DLC skins, like Santa’s Cap and Evergreen Shirt, will not drop anymore until next Christmas.
-The Xmas Tree will no longer be craftable.

Don't miss out on our Survivors Pack DLC or the stunning Serpent's Dawn Skin Pack.

Happy gaming!

Markus & Simon

notes.title: Serpents Dawn: A Fresh Start for the New Year & Ruins to Fortress!
notes.content:
Greetings, Survivors!

The Serpents Dawn Skin Pack is here! This colorful mix of styles, inspired by Chinese New Year, Japanese, and Indonesian influences, breathes new life into Ruins to Fortress. Featuring uniquely crafted skins, this pack lets you express yourself like never before, with every item individually tradable and marketable.

But Serpents Dawn isn’t just about aesthetics—it’s a symbol of renewal for us at Nimble Beasts. After addressing major bugs and introducing better anti-cheat measures, we’re now turning our focus to gameplay weaknesses. Expect exciting updates aimed at making the game more thrilling, balanced, and replayable than ever.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716333/b67084cc71d51357dc88f54403ab7d15dfd3cc32.gif

Serpents Dawn Skin Pack: Included Items


Serpent's Lantern  
A vibrant red lantern inspired by the bustling markets and festivals of ancient port cities. It casts a warm golden glow, illuminating the paths of trade, tradition, and mystery.

Wanderer's Straw Hat  
A timeless design for travelers and farmers, this versatile hat offers both shade and style for every journey.

Wanderer's Crimson Trousers  
Durable leather trousers with bold red accents, providing flexibility and protection for any adventure.

Wanderer's Crimson Jacket  
A rugged leather jacket featuring striking red details, blending traditional craftsmanship with practical functionality.

Serpents Hoard Chest  
An opulent chest adorned with intricate gold patterns and the emblem of a coiled serpent. It exudes mystery and luxury, guarding treasures steeped in ancient legends.

Serpents Vessel  
A sleek, serpent-shaped boat with fiery patterns. Graceful yet powerful, it glides through waters, embodying mystery and the promise of renewal.

Serpents Fang  
A golden axe of legendary design, radiating power and elegance. Its strikes carry the spirit of the serpent, combining deadly force with timeless grace.

Serpents Bushido Armor  
Ornate armor inspired by samurai traditions, featuring intricate serpent motifs and crimson highlights. A symbol of resilience, honor, and the wisdom of the serpent.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716333/f60376e27fafd046dff6961b32013708716f4dd0.png

This is your chance to own a piece of Ruins to Fortress history! The Serpents Dawn Skin Pack is only available until March 31. After that, neither the pack nor individual skins will be sold by us again. They’ll only be obtainable through the Steam Community Market, likely at higher prices.

As a token of our gratitude, all Survivor's Pack DLC owners will receive:

 A Serpents Dawn skin for free - if they play during the event.
 Three new Backwall Tiles in the same vibrant theme


Claim these treasures and make them your own before they vanish into legend! 🐍✨

notes.title: Happy Holidays from the Ruins to Fortress Team!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716333/4abd4435eecf7b7fb2e805adf83f695618c42dc2.gif

To all our players celebrating Christmas, the holidays, or simply enjoying a festive season, we wish you warmth, joy, and wonderful moments. And to those who don’t celebrate, we hope you’re having a peaceful and cozy end to the year.

We want to take this moment to express our heartfelt gratitude to everyone who has supported us, shared valuable feedback, and purchased our DLC. Your involvement means the world to us and helps shape Ruins to Fortress into a better experience for all.

We also want to address an issue many of you have raised: cheaters. This has been a significant problem that we unfortunately underestimated. While we anticipated some cheating, we assumed it would be limited to gaining small advantages. Sadly, we’ve realized that many cheaters are primarily focused on ruining the experience for others. We understand how frustrating it is to invest hours into building a beautiful base, only to have it destroyed in seconds. The negative reviews we’ve received about this are entirely valid, and we hear you loud and clear. We are committed to tackling this issue.

As a result, our first development sprint in the new year will prioritize fixing this issue over introducing new features. That said, we still have exciting plans for early 2025:
- Character Customization: A character editor to let you fully personalize your player avatar, with even more customization options coming later.  
- New PvE Content: Expect new maps, enemies, unique locations, and fresh challenges to enhance the PvE experience.

Upcoming Skinpack: Serpent's Dawn

Our seasonal Christmas event will wrap up in January and seamlessly transition into the launch of our first skin pack: Serpent's Dawn. This pack is designed to celebrate the Year of the Snake while highlighting and honoring various Asian cultures. It features a striking collection of skins inspired by Asian traditions and aesthetics, with a predominant focus on vibrant red and golden hues. Highlights include simple yet elegant outfits, a magnificent golden axe skin, and ornate decorations for your base that capture the essence of these rich cultural influences.

The Serpent's Dawn skin pack will only be available for purchase for three months and will not be in the store afterward. However, all items in the pack will be tradeable and marketable for you, meaning you can exchange or sell them with other players. Owners of the DLC who log in during the event period will receive one of the skins from the pack for free—so don’t miss out!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716333/427fc2d1048b0df3821378f636e36f41f2784880.png

The revenue from the DLC and skin packs will help us ensure the continued development of Ruins to Fortress and allow us to dedicate more time to improving and expanding the game. Your support directly contributes to making Ruins to Fortress the best experience it can be.

Once again, thank you for being part of the Ruins to Fortress journey. Your support and passion make it all possible. For those eager to stay up-to-date, we are sharing more detailed milestone plans on our Discord server, where you’ll also find more regular updates on our progress. Join us there to be part of the journey and share your feedback!

We wish you all a happy holiday season and a fantastic start to the new year. Let’s make 2025 unforgettable together! 🎉

Warm regards,  
The Ruins to Fortress Team

notes.title: Launch Day Recap: A Big Thank You! Gratitude, Challenges, and Moving Forward!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716333/ae66cb8403c94d10f9e146412761d6a93cdecf38.gif

Thank you for playing Ruins to Fortress in its early days!

We’re happy to see the game up and running for most player, our biggest fear was things not starting at all. We even peaked at around 400 players!

There were some initial issues with the free early adopter skin shirt not dropping, but that should be resolved now.

Mago and I had a great time playing on the official servers with the community at the start—about 25 players joined in. It was chaotic (in the best way)! We were impressed by how quickly everyone picked up the mechanics. We’re a small two-person indie dev/artist team, and playing with you or watching your streams has been incredibly valuable. It’s helped us identify bottlenecks in the game and even stress-test the servers.

That said, we’ve already received reports of cheating, especially on the official servers. Some high player count servers even crashed at one point! Addressing these issues is a priority, and we’ll be trying to scaling up our efforts while the game is in Early Access. Cheating is always a cat-and-mouse game, but we’re on it. Currently, if you’re hosting a game, you can set a password or use the console to kick and ban players as needed.

We’re thinking about the best strategies and anti-cheat measures to implement in the coming months.   

We understand how frustrating it can be to enjoy the game for six hours, only to have a cheater destroy your base in an instant. If you have a saved game, you can reload it and set your server to password-protected to prevent this from happening again.

We’re reviewing all the improvement suggestions and bug reports you’ve shared. I’ll focus on addressing the most urgent issues first and schedule the rest for future updates.

Early Access
Ruins to Fortress is currently in Early Access, which means some features may still be incomplete or missing, and you might encounter occasional bugs. Your feedback is essential in helping us refine the game and bring it closer to both your expectations and our vision.

Join us on Discord to share your ideas, report issues, and connect with the team—we’re always listening and eager to hear your thoughts!

notes.title: The Road Ahead - Release, Roadmap and Pricing
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716333/ae66cb8403c94d10f9e146412761d6a93cdecf38.gif

First of all, we want to thank you for 5000 wishlist additions! 
This means a lot to us and motivates us to keep going. The Open World Survival Crafting Fest and the Steam Next Fest were successful promotional events that brought us many new players who tested our demo. This resulted in many bug fixes, especially in so-called edge cases, meaning errors in situations that rarely occur. We also received many improvement suggestions, which we have discussed both internally and with you.

Even though we had a specific internal plan, many goals for the future were still vague. Therefore, we have, together with you, determined which feature packages should be completed before the release and created a roadmap. We also considered how we could monetize our game to ensure continued development.

Roadmap

Electricity Update
- Implement power generators
- Electric lights
- Satoshi miners
- Some more gadgets

Animal Taming Update
- Adding tameable creatures with unique abilities

Raid Kits Update
- Create specialized equipment sets for different raiding strategies
- Balance raid kits for fair and exciting gameplay

Cosmetic Skins Update
- Design a variety of skins for characters and equipment

Multiple Maps and Biomes Update
- Develop distinct maps, each featuring unique challenges
- Create diverse biomes

All added features will not be feature-complete but will lay the foundation for more content to be added. The scheduled release is Friday, the 13th of December. What could go wrong?

Early Access and Pricing
After nearly two years of development, we will have implemented a large portion of the planned features and plan to go into Early Access. We see this step as essential to improve the quality and quantity of content. Before the release, we will release a post-release roadmap that will outline the path to version 1.0 and hint at what content is planned afterward. Since PvE content is very time-consuming to develop, we have decided to postpone much of it until next year and focus on PvP content until the release.

As an indie game studio, it is very difficult to release a multiplayer game because you compete not only with other small indie studios but also with large studios with major titles. Most large multiplayer games are therefore free and are financed through expensive skins, pay-to-win elements, pointless in-game currencies, and unnecessary battle passes.
And believe us, we hate these mechanisms as much as you do and still fall for them often enough. That is why we have decided on a model that will be attractive to you and still cover the development costs.
We will start Early Access with a Free to Play model. Additionally, there will be a DLC that will unlock additional non-gameplay relevant content. This will include unlocking skins and the ability to host additional maps or game modes - joining a server with additional content will still be free. With a low, fair price, we want to ensure that as many players as possible can afford this upgrade and support us.

So far, these are the current plans. Of course, these can still change, so please don't be mad at us if they do.
What is your opinion on this?

Thank you for reading.

notes.title: The Demo Is Live!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716333/56909de7ee8134e755bcb967aac421c6b21f2f91.png

Dear Community,

The time has come – our demo is live! For a year now, mago and crimi have been tirelessly working on this game, and we're eager to hear your feedback. For a long time, we could only test the game in small sessions, either together or with friends. But now, we believe it's ready to present you with a playable version. Currently, about 90% of our ideas have been implemented and integrated. There may still be the occasional bug lurking in the game. We hope you'll have sessions with as few bugs as possible, but please bear with us if that's not the case.

To help you get started, we've prepared plenty of additional content for you:
- A demo FAQ is available.
- There are guides in various languages.
- A wiki listing all available items among other things.

As for the future of the demo:
We see the demo as an ongoing public beta. After addressing initial bugs, we aim to gradually incorporate the remaining 10% and consider your feedback until we have a game that satisfies both you and us. Only then will we release the full version.

Limitations of the demo:
Currently, about 10% of the content is still missing. We also plan to offer different maps containing various biomes and differing in size. Later on, we hope to enable randomly generated maps.
Additionally, the game world is not yet persistently saved. This means that if the server goes down, the world disappears. We aim to change this in the coming months.
Furthermore, language support is currently limited to English. Although there isn't a lot of text in the game, we haven't had the opportunity yet to integrate support for multiple languages. Based on the demand we see in the demo, we currently plan to support the following languages: French, German, Spanish, Portuguese.

Thanks for reading!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716333/5e4b561dff1c50f86c4bff2b5234ab6bab68b4f4.jpg

notes.title: Ruins To Fortress: First Demo Launch
notes.content:
Get ready for "Ruins to Fortress," a new survival game! In this game, you'll try to stay alive in a world that's fallen apart. Soon, we're releasing a free demo for everyone to try.

What's "Ruins to Fortress"?

It's a game where you and others play together online, trying to survive on an island full of dangers. You'll make weapons, build safe places, and battle others to be the last one standing.

Why Try the Demo?

1. We Want Your Thoughts: Tell us what you like and what we can make better.
2. Find Bugs: Help us spot and fix any problems.
3. Test Our Servers: We're checking to make sure our game can handle lots of players without issues.
4. Make It Fun for Everyone: We'll adjust the game based on your feedback to make sure it's fun and fair.

Join the Adventure:
We're excited for you to try "Ruins to Fortress" and help us make it an amazing game. Whether you're a gaming pro or new to survival games, there's something here for you.

Ready to take on the challenge and make your mark in "Ruins to Fortress"?
